West Pakistan Ordinance No. VIII of 1965
AN ORDINANCE
to provide for the termination' of services of
undesirable employees of they, Road Transport Board
1. Short title and commencement.‑(1) This Ordinance may be
called the (Sub, for "Road Tmasport Corporation ("west Pakistan), Ibid.)[North West Frontier Province Road
Transport Board) Removal of Undesirable Employees Ordinance, 1965.
1(Sec. 4‑A added by Punjab Act No. 1 of 1975, s. 2 in its
application to the Punjab.)
2Subs. for "Corporation', ibid, s. 2 (b)
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

2. Definitions.‑‑ (Sec. 2 subs. for the original, by N. W. F. P. Act V of 1974, s. 3.)1n this Ordinance, unless the context otherwise requires, the
following expressions shall hove the meanings hereby res pectively assigned to
them, the, is to say‑
(a) appropriate authority' means ‑
(i) Government in the case of employees appointed by Government,
or persons whose services have been
trans ferred by Government to the Board;
(ii) Board in the case of employees appointed by the Board; and
(iii) General Manager in the case of employees appointed by an
authority or officer subordinate to the
Board;
(b) Board' means the North‑West Frontier Province Road
Trans port Board established
under section 70 of the West Pakistan Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965 (W. P. Ord. XIX of 1965);
(c) employee' means any person serving in connection with the
affairs of the Board, including
a person whose services have been transferred to the Board, but does not include a person on depution
from a Government Department;
(d) General Manager' means the General Manager of the Board; and
(e) 'Government' means the Government of the North‑West
Frontier Province.]

sections.shortTitle: Road Transport Corporation N -W F P Removal of Undesirable Employees Ordinance 1965
sections.description:
Termination of service

N
NORTH WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE ROAD TRANSPORT BOARD REMOVAL
OF UNDESIRABLE EMPLOYEES ORDINANCE, 1965
(Gaz. of West Pak. Extr. 17 May 1965, p.
2237.)
[Approved by the Provincial
Assembly. of West Pakistan in pursuance
of Clause (3) of Article 79 of the Constitution]
[13
May 1965]
West Pakistan Ordinance No. VIII of 1965
AN ORDINANCE
to provide for the termination' of services of
undesirable employees of they, Road Transport Board
3. Termination of service.‑If in the opinion of the
appropriate authority any employee is undesirable and it is expedient, in the
public interest, to terminate his services, the appropriate authority may,
notwith- standing anything to the contrary contained in any law, rule or
instrument having the force of law‑
(i) after giving such employee a reasonable opportunity to show
cause against the action proposed to be
taken against him, terminate his services ; and
(ii) direct that such gratuity or Provident Fund as may be admis sible
to such employee under the
rules and specified in the older be paid to him.

sections.shortTitle: Road Transport Corporation N -W F P Removal of Undesirable Employees Ordinance 1965
sections.description:
Appeal

N
NORTH WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE ROAD TRANSPORT BOARD REMOVAL
OF UNDESIRABLE EMPLOYEES ORDINANCE, 1965
(Gaz. of West Pak. Extr. 17 May 1965, p.
2237.)
[Approved by the Provincial
Assembly. of West Pakistan in pursuance
of Clause (3) of Article 79 of the Constitution]
[13
May 1965]
West Pakistan Ordinance No. VIII of 1965
AN ORDINANCE
to provide for the termination' of services of
undesirable employees of they, Road Transport Board
4. Appeal.‑(1) Any employee in respect of whom an order
terminat ing his services has been made under section 3 by the (Subs. for "Chairman" ibid,
a. 2.)(General Manager] or the (Subs.. for "Corporation" ibid.)[Board], may, within fifteen days of
the communication to him of the order, appeal against the order to Government,
and the order made in appeal shall be final.
(2) Where an order of retirement
under section 3 has been made by Government, no appeal shall lie against such
order, but the person in respect of whom such an order has been made, may,
within fifteen days of the communication to him of such order, apply for review
of the order to Government, and any order passed in review shall be final.

Protection taken under the Ordinance

N
NORTH WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE ROAD TRANSPORT BOARD REMOVAL
OF UNDESIRABLE EMPLOYEES ORDINANCE, 1965
(Gaz. of West Pak. Extr. 17 May 1965, p.
2237.)
[Approved by the Provincial
Assembly. of West Pakistan in pursuance
of Clause (3) of Article 79 of the Constitution]
[13
May 1965]
West Pakistan Ordinance No. VIII of 1965
AN ORDINANCE
to provide for the termination' of services of
undesirable employees of they, Road Transport Board
5. Protection taken under the
Ordinance.‑No suit, prosecution or other legal proceedings shall lie
against Government, the (Subs.. for "Corporation" ibid.) [Board] or any other officer or
servant of the (Subs.. for "Corporation" ibid.) [Board] for anything in good faith
done or intended to be done under this Ordinance.
